Chapter 1

The Ride

"It was 25 May… a normal day, but something special was about to happen."

ALLENCome, I'll drop you on my bike.
ALEENANo… I don't want to come. 😒

But after some convincing, she finally came along…

"It was noon, and Allen asked…"

ALLENAre you hungry? Shall we eat something?
ALEENANo, I'm not hungry.

Then suddenly… the sky had a different plan. 🌧️
Rain started while they were riding — and they stopped right in front of Arya's Hotel.

They stepped inside Arya's Hotel, escaping the rain. The cozy warmth inside was a perfect break from the weather outside.

ALLENWhat would you like to eat?
ALEENAI don't want anything.

She quietly sat down at the table, insisting she wasn't hungry. A few moments later, the waiter walked over.

ALLEN (to the waiter)Two masala dosas, please.

Aleena looked up in surprise.

ALEENAWhat…? One is for me? I don't like masala dosa! 😮

Allen smiled, trying not to laugh.

ALLENOkay then… two ghee roasts, please. 😊

Soon, two hot, crispy ghee roasts arrived at the table. As the rain tapped gently on the windows, they shared a quiet meal and an even quieter happiness.

After they finished eating, the rain had stopped, and they continued their journey.

Allen dropped Aleena at the bus stop and waited until her bus arrived.

When the bus came, she left… but that small moment became a beautiful memory. 💕

Aleena ❤️

I pray that we always grow together, support each other, and become a blessing in each other's lives. You are not just someone I love — you are someone I want to choose every day.
I promise to be there in your happy moments and difficult days, to listen, care, and walk with you as we grow together.
Allen & Aleena 💍
